adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, it tries to resolve a credential from `this.calendarCredentials`, and if not found, fetches from DB via `prisma.credential.findUnique(...)`. If the DB fetch returns null (or lacks `app.slug` so `credential` is never constructed), the code simply falls through without pushing any `EventResult` and without any logging/error handling. This means that destination calendar will receive no event and the failure is silent, matching the finding.
